name: F5-TTS_bench
description: A text-to-speech (TTS) benchmark that evaluates the quality of synthesized speech across a variety of prompts and voices. It measures attributes such as naturalness, intelligibility, and prosody by comparing model-generated audio to reference human recordings. Designed to assess TTS systems' fidelity and expressiveness across different utterances and styles.
reputation: A niche, community-contributed benchmark on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for TTS evaluation.
